exchangeFormat: NE (CT/ME/MA/NH/RI/VT): RST + state+county code (e.g. MAWOR; CT uses Regional Councils of Government). Non-NE: RST + state/province; DX: RST + 'DX'. Bands 80-10m. Phone/CW (CW includes digital). NE works everyone; non-NE works NE only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE PER CONTEST). Pts: Phone 1, CW 2 (CW includes digital). NE entrant mult = each US state (DC→MD) + each Canadian province (14; VO1/VO2 separate) + each DXCC country (not USA); an in-NE station's state+county code contributes its leading 2-char STATE token. Non-NE entrant mult = distinct NE county codes (68: CT 9 / MA 14 / ME 16 / NH 10 / RI 5 / VT 14). NE works everyone for pts; non-NE scores NE contacts only. Mobiles county-change = new QSO + new county; county-line = 2 QSOs. Claimed/running — the NEQP committee re-adjudicates. Assumes the logged NE token is <2-char state><county> (per the 'send state and county' exchange); CT Regional-Councils-of-Government codes and the Canadian-area '14' / DXCC counts are claimed (committee re-adjudicates).
